note: [L]'s induction hypothesis is the total bound `Achieves` at the finer partition, with abstract budgets `bag`, `shadow` and test order `(2+sum d)*d'`; the per-shell bound `(rho/R)^γ` is derived from it in `cost_one` rather than being the hypothesis.

snippet.text:
structure Achieves [Fintype I] (Z : Final C F S) (M : Devices Z.sector.derivatives) (r : Route P Q I W) (T : W→ Cells S d) (B : W→ℝ) (D : Reader E W X k Z.sector.derivatives) (γ : ℝ)(c : ℝ): Prop where
   estimates (f : Menu k)(w : W) (p : SmoothTests E){m : ℝ}(hp: tsupport p.val ⊆ r.stage w)
       (hx: Jet (stairs d Q) univ (composed (r.frame w) p).val m) : Dust (r.windings M D T f w p) (c*m*r.bag d B w (generosity Q γ)* shadow Q f γ)

proof_context.conclusion: The induction statement `Achieves` bounds `windings f w p` by `c*m*bag*shadow`, with the loss `generosity Q γ` in `bag` and tests of jet order `stairs d Q`.

lemma cost_one (hB : ∀ w,0<B w)(hh: Economy Q γ)
  (hy : ∀ v:Splittings i.val, ∃ C>(0:ℝ), Achieves Z M (r.renew i (outward b) u v h) (fun p=>T p.val.1) (r.promise i b u v B) (r.listener M i b u v D) γ C) : ∃ C>(0:ℝ),∀ (f:Menu k) w (z:SmoothTests E)(c:ℝ), tsupport z.val ⊆ r.stage w → Jet (stairs d Q) univ (composed (r.frame w) z).val c → ∀ n,
            Dust (r.beckon M T D i b f w z n) (C*c*r.bag d B w (generosity Q γ)* (dyad n)^γ*behind Q i f γ) := by

proof_context.conclusion: Each dyadic shell arm `beckon n` costs at most `C*c*bag*(dyad n)^γ*behind`, the ratio gain `(rho/R)^γ` times the parent bag.
